headline: Drake Maye Named AFC Offensive Player of the Week
summary: The Patriots announced that QB Drake Maye has been named AFC Offensive Player of the Week for his 3-touchdown performance in the Patriots 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills last Sunday.

headline: Patriots Release LB Jose Ramirez; Sign CB Al'Zillion Hamilton to the Practice Squad; Release OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon from the Practice Squad
summary: The Patriots announced that they have released LB Jose Ramirez. In addition, the Patriots signed rookie CB Al’Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad and released rookie OL Da’Metrius Weatherspoon from the practice squad.

headline: Patriots to Honor Adam Vinatieri During Halftime Ceremony on Sunday, October 11 Against Raiders
summary: The New England Patriots will celebrate Adam Vinatieri's induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame during a halftime ceremony on Sunday, October 11 against the Las Vegas Raiders.

headline: Patriots shut down Dalton Kincaid but have Brock Bowers, Michael Mayer looming
summary: The Patriots neutralized a red-hot Kincaid in Week 4 but know they have their work cut out for them against the Raiders' 1-2 tight end punch in Week 5.

headline: Drake Maye rebounds as Patriots hand Bills first defeat
summary: Drake Maye snapped out of his early-season slide with a clutch performance as the New England Patriots upset the Buffalo Bills 29-26 at Highmark Stadium in a result that coach Mike Vrabel highlighted as critical for the defending AFC champions.

headline: Maye overcomes his two turnovers with 3 TD passes in Patriots' 29-26 win over Bills
summary: — Drake Maye didn’t have to be perfect after his rough start to the season.
